user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to display in ChatGPT search results.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content potentially used in training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Performs user-triggered actions and fetches in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Visits pages or interacts with external apps upon user request.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated actions; robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content for AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for training generative AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive in robots.txt for ClaudeBot.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content in response to user queries in Claude AI.
user_agents.scope: User-directed web retrieval and query response visibility.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive in robots.txt for Claude-User.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes online content to improve search result quality and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Indexing web content for search optimization.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive in robots.txt for Claude-SearchBot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Finds information for building Google's search indexes and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google Images and search features presenting images.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and image features in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: Googlebot-Image or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video content for video-related search features.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: Googlebot-Video or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for the Google News product.
user_agents.scope: Google News product, including news.google.com and Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: Googlebot-News or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Performs crawls for Search testing tools.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for fetching publicly accessible content for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Product teams for one-off crawls and internal research and development.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Product teams fetching publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Product teams fetching publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents crawl requests requested by site owners.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Manages content usage for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Training Gemini models for Gemini Apps, Vertex AI API, and Grounding.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet to improve search experience.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet for user requests or search.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple products and trains generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: General search web crawling and rendering across the web for Apple ecosystem.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for training Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Secondary user agent that does not crawl webpages but controls AI training data usage.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Crawls URLs for registered Apple Podcasts content.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps to generate previews.
user_agents.scope: Websites and apps shared on Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improves Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Web content to enhance Meta AI relevance and citations.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improves advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: General web content for advertising use cases.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Trains foundation AI models and indexes content for product improvement.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled directly for AI training and indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request for agentic AI tasks.
user_agents.scope: Individual web links requested by users.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules due to user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content for Bing search and Microsoft AI features.
user_agents.scope: Web search and AI-powered search index generation.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Bingbot.

user_agents.name: MicrosoftPreview
user_agents.purpose: Fetches real-time web snapshots and previews for Bing and Copilot.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated requests and preview generation.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: MicrosoftPreview.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to provide accurate info and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt or noarchive/noindex robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user actions by fetching live information for user queries.
user_agents.scope: Live fetching on user behalf; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to build an open dataset for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset of the web for open data archiving.
user_agents.opt_out: Set Disallow: / for CCBot in robots.txt or request opt-out registry.
